title: India arrests over 200 linked to Pakistan-based terror network
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced that security forces have dismantled an ISI-backed terror network led by Shahzad Bhatti. Over 200 operatives were arrested across 14 states ahead of India's Independence Day. The operation targeted individuals allegedly involved in terror activities and aimed to disrupt plots planned for the national holiday.
summary_points: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced the dismantling of an ISI-backed terror network.
The network was allegedly led by Shahzad Bhatti.
Over 200 operatives were arrested across 14 states.
The arrests occurred ahead of India's Independence Day.
The operation aimed to prevent terror plots during the national holiday.
title_hi: भारत ने पाकिस्तान स्थित आतंकी नेटवर्क से जुड़े 200 से अधिक लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया
summary_hi: केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने घोषणा की कि सुरक्षा बलों ने“शहजाद“भट्टी के नेतृत्व वाले“आईएसआई-समर्थित“आतंकवादी नेटवर्क को“नष्ट“कर दिया है। भारत के स्वतंत्रता दिवस से पहले 14 राज्यों में 200 से अधिक“ऑपरेटिव“गिरफ्तार किए गए। इस“ऑपरेशन“का उद्देश्य राष्ट्रीय“छुट्टी“के दौरान“आतंकवादी“गतिविधियों और“साजिशों“को“रोकना“था।
summary_points_hi: केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने“आईएसआई-समर्थित“आतंकवादी नेटवर्क के“नष्ट“किए जाने की घोषणा की।
यह नेटवर्क कथित तौर पर“शहजाद“भट्टी के नेतृत्व में“संचालित“हो रहा था।

center: Security forces busted an ISI-backed terror network led by Shahzad Bhatti.
Over 200 operatives were arrested across 14 states ahead of Independence Day.
The announcement was made by Union Home Minister Amit Shah.
